description: Hi, I'm Jodie (she/her). I'm a clinical psychologist, EMDR therapist, and Credentialed Eating Disorder Clinician with a background in clinical exercise physiology. I’m a clinical psychologist, Credentialed Eating Disorder Clinician, and EMDR therapist, with a background in clinical exercise physiology. I can help with: •	Relational trauma, including attachment difficulties, early life experiences, and complex family relationships •	PTSD and complex trauma, including child and adult emotional, physical, and sexual abuse •	Depression •	Anxiety •	Stress and challenging life experiences, including work, study, and relationship difficulties •	Perfectionism, low self-worth I offer sessions via telehealth and in-person in Ferntree Gully VIC

name: Fiona Mawson
title: Psychologist
description: Fiona Mawson is a Counselling and Clinical Psychologist who helps people navigate life’s challenges, whether they’re dealing with mild stress or more complex psychological issues. She is an Accredited EMDR Practitioner and Consultant, and founded EMDR Consulting, a service that supports and trains EMDR therapists to deliver high-quality, effective therapy. Fiona also co-trains with the EMDR Academy and EMDR Stepping Stones, offering refresher and advanced EMDR courses for therapists working with complex cases.
